short_scenes.caption: A LION.
short_scenes.narration: A lion. Huge. Hungry. Its golden eyes locked on John. He had only a wooden spear.

short_scenes.caption: He didn't run.
short_scenes.narration: Every instinct screamed run. But Mia was behind him. John planted his feet, and raised the spear.

short_scenes.caption: The lion leapt.
short_scenes.narration: The lion leapt. Claws flashed. John screamed and thrust with everything he had.

short_scenes.caption: Then… silence.
short_scenes.narration: Then silence. Mia ran to the grass. And saw blood. A lot of blood.

short_scenes.caption: Did John survive? What do you think?
short_scenes.narration: Did John survive? What do you think? Follow so you don't miss the next part.
